title: File:Halemaumau Crater quadrupled from Uwekahuna bluff (44101540681).jpg
author: Hawai‘i Volcanoes NPS
description:
Panoramic photograph of Halemaumau Crater and Kilauea Caldera on August 17, 2018. The diameter of the deep inner pit is now 1.5 km, and the maximum depth is about 450 meters, according to USGS. The outer collapse diameter is about 2 x 3 km. 
NPS_Photo_Janice Wei
credit: Halemaumau Crater quadrupled from Uwekahuna bluff (44101540681).jpg by Hawai‘i Volcanoes NPS, via Wikimedia Commons, Public domain
